_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang unchanged at its tagged 0.51.1; beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.70.3, which only rewrites the in-app What's new list to be easier to read. beamlynx-ui 0.70.3 still needs pine-lang 0.51 (its RequiredVersion).
